description: Matcher output: candidate links for one unmatched bank entry or merchant record.

entry.description: The entry being matched, copied from the supplied material.

candidates.description: Every candidate considered, including rejected ones.

signals.description: Short observations such as 'amount equal', 'reference RH-PO-7781 appears in both', 'booked 15h after release'.

decision.description: linked only when exactly one compatible candidate remains; ambiguous when more than one stays plausible; unmatched when none fits.

chosen_record_id.description: The record_id of the linked candidate, or an empty string when the decision is not 'linked'.

chosen_revision.description: The revision of the linked candidate, or 0 when the decision is not 'linked'.
